As we kick off the approval process for this year's team appreciation event, I'd like to go around and hear from each of you about any constraints or implementation needs we should be aware of. Please share anything that could affect the format, schedule, participation, or communications plan so I can document it properly before signing off.

Last year, I personally observed three separate occasions during that round when remote or quieter employees were called on unexpectedly and became visibly uncomfortable. I didn't include this in the event retrospective because that retrospective focused on attendance and logistics, but I think it's important to document as we consider this year's format and participation rules.
